references.text: Achan took from the devoted things, which led to Israel's defeat, just as warned in Joshua 6:18
God explains how Israel has taken from the devoted things and thus become devoted themselves, as predicted in the warning
Achan and his family were punished for taking from the devoted things, fulfilling the warning of disaster over the camp
Reference to Achan's sin with the devoted things that brought wrath upon all the congregation of Israel
The Mosaic law forbids taking anything devoted into one's house, for then one becomes devoted oneself
The law that nothing of what is devoted shall remain in one's hand, so that the Lord may turn from His anger
Achan is mentioned in David's genealogy as 'Achar' (the troubler), who brought disaster upon Israel by unfaithfulness regarding the devoted things
